simple.meaning: דֵּעַ (dêaʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “knowledge.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 5 times across Job, beginning at Job 32:6. Its contexts include family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דֵּעַ (H1843).

definitions.full: H1843. dea [ דֵּעַ ] noun [masculine] knowledge, opinion (late) — only suffix דֵּעִי Job 32:6 3 t., and plural דֵּעִים 37:6 ; all in speech of Elihu. 1 knowledge , ד ׳תְּמִים Job 37:16 one perfect in knowledge (of God). 2 judgement, opinion Job 36:3 ; דֵּעִי חַֹוּת 32:6 to declare my opinion , so 32:10 ; 32:17 .

occurrences.englishText: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered,
I also will answer my part,
I will get my knowledge from afar,
Do you know the workings of the clouds,
